COA Major – Additions/Modifications
Additions to or partial demolition of existing structures – change
to lot coverage, floor area, height, setbacks and/or roof shape.
Modifications to exterior building materials or site features – no
change to lot coverage, floor area, height, setbacks and/or roof.

Variance
Single-Family, Multi-Family, or Non-Residential & Mixed Use

The Historic Preservation Section strongly encourages applicants to schedule a Pre-Application Meeting prior
to the submission of any major project.
A1
Historic Preservation Board Project Checklist, completed

A Public Notice Mailer is required for all projects presented to the HPB. Once the application has been reviewed
and deemed complete, city staff will provide the notice mailer electronically prior to the hearing date. It is the
responsibility of the applicant to perform the mailing. The Tax Radius Map and the List of Property Owners shall
be obtained through the Palm Beach County Property Appraiser’s Office and provided at initial submittal.
N1
Tax Radius Map identifying all properties within a 500 ft. radius of the subject property.
D2

Property Survey reflecting current conditions of the parcel and providing all pertinent setbacks and
illustrating existing lot coverages. For parcels within a FEMA designated floodplain, spot elevations
and current finish floor elevations of existing structures may be required.
D5

WPB Historic Residential Zoning Data Table (inserted on Site Plan or Zoning Diagrams sheet) with all
applicable zoning information calculated and provided. Utilize space outside of the table to show
calculations.
D8

Demolition of a Contributing Resource Applicants should consult with Historic Preservation Staff
prior to submission. Depending on the scope and nature of the proposed demolition, additional
documentation may be required, including but not limited to staff site visits, structural engineering
reports, condition assessments, or other supporting materials.
Modifications to exterior materials or site features. No change to lot coverage, floor area, height, setbacks, or roof shape.
EA2

Property Survey reflecting current conditions of the parcel and providing all pertinent setbacks and
illustrating existing lot coverages. For parcels within a FEMA designated floodplain, spot elevations
and current finish floor elevations of existing structures may be required.
EA4

Elevation Drawings (Existing and Proposed facades on the same sheet) clearly dimensioned and
depicting all requested changes in roofing, siding, windows, doors, garage doors, porches,
architectural details, etc.
EA5

Materials Sheet/Product Information for proposed windows, doors, roofs, garage doors, etc.,
including NOA/FBC cover sheets and brochure images depicting the requested design, material, and
finish.
NC2

Property Survey reflecting current conditions of the parcel and providing all pertinent setbacks and
illustrating existing lot coverages. For parcels within a FEMA designated floodplain, spot elevations
and current finish floor elevations of existing structures may be required.
NC5

WPB Historic Residential Zoning Data Table (inserted on Site Plan or Zoning Diagrams sheet) with all
applicable zoning information calculated and provided. Utilize space outside of the table to show
calculations.
NC6

Zoning Diagrams graphically depicting Lot Coverage, Floor Area Ratio, and Front Yard Landscape Area
and/or Contextual Front Setback in plan diagram. Provide calculations.
NC12

Materials Sheet/Product Information for proposed windows, doors, roofs, garage doors, etc.,
including NOA/FBC cover sheets and brochure images depicting the requested design, material, and
finish.
Additions to or partial demolition of existing structures – change to lot coverage, floor area, height, setbacks and/or roof shape.
AM2

Property Survey reflecting current conditions of the parcel and providing all pertinent setbacks and
illustrating existing lot coverages. For parcels within a FEMA designated floodplain, spot elevations and
current finish floor elevations of existing structures may be required.
AM5

WPB Historic Residential Zoning Data Table (inserted on Site Plan or Zoning Diagrams sheet) with all
applicable zoning information calculated and provided. Utilize space outside of the table to show
calculations.
AM6

Zoning Diagrams graphically depicting Lot Coverage, Floor Area Ratio, and Front Yard Landscape Area
and/or Contextual Front Setback in plan diagram. Provide calculations.
AM

Materials Sheet/Product Information for proposed windows, doors, roofs, garage doors, etc., including
NOA/FBC cover sheets and brochure images depicting the requested design, material, and finish.
SE1

Special Exception Diagrams in plan, elevation, or section detail, clearly dimension and graphically
illustrate the Special Exception request. Portions of construction utilizing the Special Exception shall be
clearly identified. Demonstrate compliance with the specific Special Exception criteria and the alternative
dimensional standards provided in Table III-3. For Alternative Garage Location Standards, provide
documentation that pertinent conditions exist. For Special Exception requests utilizing increased
landscaping, provide a landscape plan at initial submittal. For Special Exception requests utilizing green
building standards, provide a detailed list of qualifying items. Contact staff with questions.
